typeHints.annual: 21 paid days after 6 months — 30 days after 10 years of service or at age 50 (Labour Law 12/2003)
typeHints.casual: 7 paid days per year for urgent, non-deferrable matters (Article 47)
typeHints.sick: Up to 180 days per year with an accredited medical report and statutory pay scaling
typeHints.maternity: 90 fully paid days — up to 4 times during the whole service (Article 52)
typeHints.hajj: 30 fully paid days, once during the whole service (otherwise deducted from annual leave)
typeHints.companion: 7 paid days per year to care for a sick relative
typeHints.unpaid: Unpaid leave by mutual agreement — not counted as service or pay
typeHints.sports: For employees representing the state in official competitions (Sports Law)
typeHints.compensatory: Time off in lieu of overtime hours, by management agreement
typeHints.mourning: 3 fully paid days for the death of a second-degree-or-closer relative (Civil Service Law 81/2016)
typeHints.exam: Leave to sit official exams and align with the published schedule

leaves.typeHintGeneral: Pick a leave type to see what Egyptian law provides

absenceReview.title: Absence review
absenceReview.description: Absences in the {{period}} incentive affect that incentive and the {{salaryPeriod}} salary.
absenceReview.employeesHint: They have absence days in the incentive month
absenceReview.salaryDescription: Actual from the {{period}} salary slip — expected is based on {{absencePeriod}} incentive absences.
absenceReview.incentiveDescription: Actual from the {{period}} incentive slip — expected is based on the same month's absences.
absenceReview.notesHint: Write a note on any item, then press the save icon or Enter.
absenceReview.informationalHint: An explanatory row excluded from totals
absenceReview.salarySlipMissing: The {{period}} salary slip is missing, so actual values are unavailable.
absenceReview.incentiveSlipMissing: The {{period}} incentive slip is missing, so actual values are unavailable.
absenceReview.rateMissing: No incentive rate is recorded for this employee or department — expected incentive cannot be computed.
absenceReview.basicMissing: No basic salary is recorded for this employee — expected cannot be computed.
absenceReview.expectedFormula: Expected uses a 30-day month: (basic ÷ 30) × deduction days.
absenceReview.salaryPenaltyFormula: Unauthorized absence in salary applies two items: full absence days (unauthorized absence) + penalty days 0.25 / 0.5 / 1 / 2 / 4 (unauthorized absence penalties).
absenceReview.incentiveFormula: Incentive deduction: authorized = incentive × (days ÷ 30); unauthorized = incentive × penalty rate.
absenceReview.unrelatedNote: Items unrelated to absence are matched to actual because they have no independent expected source.
absenceReview.differenceNote: Difference = actual − expected. For deductions, a positive value means over-deduction.
absenceReview.noRowsBody: Pick a month with absence days recorded in incentive slips, or adjust the search and filter.

retirements.title: Retirements report
retirements.eligibleEmptyBody: No active employees will reach the legal age — check birth dates and employment statuses.
retirements.emptyBody: An employee is retired automatically at the legal age (60) from their birth date, or manually from their file.
retirements.noResultsBody: Try adjusting the year, month or search

review.title: Retirement review
review.description: Review the retirement month's pay: actual days from the retirement date, distributed basic salary, and nature allowance.
review.salaryDescription: Actual from the {{period}} salary slip — expected uses {{days}} days ({{ratio}}) of the basic salary.
review.notesHint: Write a note on any item, then press the save icon or Enter.
review.salarySlipMissing: The {{period}} salary slip is missing, so actual values are unavailable.
review.basicMissing: No full basic salary is recorded for this employee — expected cannot be computed.
review.birthDateMissing: This employee has no birth date — the retirement date rule cannot be applied.
review.natureAllowanceMissing: The applicable department nature allowance rate is unavailable — the allowance cannot be computed.
review.previousSalarySlipMissing: The full salary slip for the previous month is unavailable; some earnings could not be prorated.
review.earningBaselineMissing: An earning item was not found in the previous month's slip; review this item manually.
review.formula: All earnings are prorated by actual days ÷ 30. Distributed basic = monthly basic × ratio. Nature allowance = distributed basic × (department rate ÷ 100). Other earnings use their value in the previous full-month slip × ratio.
review.unrelatedNote: Deductions remain at their actual values in the retirement-month slip; day proration applies to earnings.
review.noRowsBody: Pick a year/month with retirements or adjust the search and filter.
